messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: P0 - High error rate on /v1/generate in eu-west-1. Observability: 5xx spike, retries increased, latency > 3s. Paging Prod Oncall and infra team.
Prod Oncall: I'm up, pulling logs now. ETA 3m to identify if this is rollout or infra.
Alice K.: I'm seeing a steady increase in GPU OOMs on node pool gx-eu-3. Marking as potential capacity failure.
Dmitri P.: @Alice K. can you paste the pod OOM logs? also any recent platform deploys?
Alice K.: here are the k8s logs copy-paste:
```
OOMKilled container "inference-worker" pid=2314 memory=78g
Aug 22 10:12:02 node gx-eu-3 kubelet: container started
```

Prod Oncall: No deploys in the last 30m. Looks like autoscaler didn't react - pods pending before OOMs. Increasing node pool size now.
Ben L.: I've flipped a temporary routing rule to shift new requests to eu-west-2; adding 429s suppression for retries.
Carol S.: Noted customer-facing impact: several enterprise tenants saw 502s for ~11m. Capturing affected customer list now.
Eva M.: I'm drafting initial customer comms for affected tenants. Will include ETA and mitigation steps.
incident-bot: Incident declared: ID INC-2026-1954001122. Postmortem required.
Prod Oncall: Mitigation complete - node pool scaled + rolling restart. Error rate back to baseline at 10:33 UTC.
Alice K.: Confirming KV cache warmed and no further OOMs observed. Monitoring 30m.
Dmitri P.: Root cause appears to be a combination of slower autoscaler responses + a recent model quantization change that increased per-worker memory by ~8GB.
Ben L.: Action item: revert quantization config for the model variant used by high-traffic tenants. Owner: @Dmitri P. ETA: EOD.
Carol S.: Action item: compile affected tenant list and prepare billing impact estimate for finance. Owner: @Carol S. ETA: tomorrow 11:00 UTC.
Eva M.: Action item: post-incident customer note and update support tickets. Owner: @Eva M. ETA: 12:00 UTC.
Dmitri P.: I'll open the postmortem doc and schedule the blameless RCA. Proposing 2026-08-23 15:00 UTC for the postmortem runbook. Anyone blocked?
Alice K.: good slot for eng-infra.
Ben L.: works for me.
incident-bot: Reminder: add the incident artifacts (traces, heap dumps, scaling events) to the postmortem doc.
Dmitri P.: Created PM doc: https://redwood.internal/pm/INC-1954001122 - added initial timeline and logs.
Carol S.: Finance heads-up: based on preliminary checks, 3 enterprise customers had >5 minutes of erroring requests. We should estimate SLA credit exposure. @finance-bot can you assist with the calc template?
finance-bot: Hi! I can produce a draft SLA credit estimate. Please provide: 1) list of affected tenants, 2) minutes of impact per tenant, 3) contract SLA details (pct availability & credit policy).
Carol S.: supplying list now.```
Tenant-A: 11 minutes impacted
Tenant-B: 9 minutes impacted
Tenant-C: 13 minutes impacted
```
Carol S.: Contracts: Tenant-A 99.9% availability (credit pro-rated), Tenant-B enterprise SLA 99.95% (credit policy: 10% monthly invoice for >10 mins), Tenant-C 99.9%.
finance-bot: Draft estimate produced and attached to the incident doc. Example calc snippet:
```
Tenant-A: monthly charge $20,000 -> pro-rated credit = (11/43200)*$20,000 ≈ $5.09
Tenant-B: monthly charge $50,000 -> policy triggers flat 10% credit = $5,000
Tenant-C: monthly charge $12,000 -> pro-rated credit = (13/43200)*$12,000 ≈ $3.61
Total potential credit ~ $5,009
```
Dmitri P.: Noted. We'll mark finance action item: reconcile actual billable usage and apply credit if incident qualifies. Owner: @Eva M. + finance team. ETA: next 3 business days.
Ben L.: Also adding remediation item: autoscaler health checks to alert at 70% memory usage, and make quantization config change gated behind perf test. Owner: @Alice K. ETA: 2 weeks.
Alice K.: I'll PR a change to autoscaler tuning and add a canary for model config changes.
Prod Oncall: Handoff to next oncall in 1h. Leaving notes in the incident doc.
Dmitri P.: Postmortem meeting confirmed for 2026-08-23 15:00 UTC. Invite sent to eng, infra, product, support, finance.
Carol S.: Finance will wait for final tenant impact numbers before issuing credits. I'll ping billing ops when the postmortem finalizes the minutes.
Eva M.: I've updated support tickets and queued the customer communication drafts for review.
incident-bot: Incident resolved. Status: mitigated -> stable. Duration: 32 minutes.
Dmitri P.: Closing notes: please add any follow-ups to the action item section in the PM doc. I'll run a quick regression test next deploy to ensure quantization change doesn't reintroduce memory regression.
Ben L.: :white_check_mark: thanks everyone.
Alice K.: logging task: add a memory-footprint test to CI for model variants. Owner: @Alice K. ETA: 2026-09-06.
finance-bot: Finance action item recorded: create SLA credit ticket for billing ops with attached estimates. Owner: Billing Ops. ETA: 3 business days.
Carol S.: assigning post-incident follow-up tracker: ACTION-INC-1954001122 to track all items. I'll update status weekly.
Eva M.: If anyone needs copies of customer comms, ping me.
Dmitri P.: Thanks team. We'll publish final postmortem after the RCA and remediation verification.
